channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Presidente do TSE defende “inteligência democrática” contra uso abusivo de IA
item.description: TSE President Minister Nunes Marques advocated for 'democratic intelligence' to counter the abusive use of AI in the 2026 elections, warning of risks posed by deepfakes, disinformation, and voter manipulation through data profiling. He emphasized that the Electoral Justice is continuously preparing to confront these digital threats, which directly undermine the formation of popular will. Despite having led the Court for less than a week, he expressed confidence in the TSE’s technical work to ensure secure and harmonious elections.

item.title: Depois de críticas de Gilmar, Zema reage: ‘O Brasil de verdade não fala português rebuscado’
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema, a presidential pre-candidate, responded to criticism from Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes by stating that 'the real Brazil does not speak ornate Portuguese' and pledged an 'implacable plan' centered on privatizations, reduced public spending, crime reduction, and confronting Brasília's 'untouchables'. Zema also emphasized that, during his tenure in Minas Gerais, he treated mayors across the ideological spectrum equally and criticized the federal government for overburdening municipalities without providing sufficient resources.

item.title: Não é papel do governo financiar carros e táxis novos
item.description: The Lula government announced a measure via Provisional Measure to finance vehicle purchases of up to R$150,000 for taxi and app drivers, with repayment terms of up to six years and subsidized interest rates through BNDES. The estimated cost to the Treasury is R$30 billion, fully borne by taxpayers, and is characterized as an electoral move to boost President Lula’s popularity.

item.title: Joaquim Barbosa e sua baixa presença nas redes
item.description: Joaquim Barbosa, former STF president attempting a return to the presidential race as a pre-candidate in 2026, has virtually disappeared from social media, diminishing his political engagement and public visibility. His absence contrasts sharply with the critical role digital platforms play in modern electoral mobilization. The article suggests this online silence may hinder his ability to connect with voters and gauge popular support.

item.title: Decreto determina que big techs devem prevenir conteúdos criminosos
item.description: President Lula signed a decree updating Brazil's Marco Civil da Internet, requiring big tech platforms to proactively prevent the spread of criminal content, including digital fraud, online scams, child sexual exploitation, and violence against women. The decree assigns the National Data Protection Authority (ANPD) the role of regulating and enforcing compliance, in line with a prior STF ruling that called for operational details on platform liability.

item.title: Entenda se Deltan Dallagnol pode disputar o Senado em 2026 após perder mandato há três anos
item.description: Former Operation Car Wash prosecutor Deltan Dallagnol, whose federal deputy mandate was annulled by the TSE in May 2023, is facing debates over his eligibility to run for Senate in 2026. While his allies claim he is eligible, PT politicians such as Zeca Dirceu and Gleisi Hoffmann assert he is barred for eight years due to his TSE conviction. Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes overturned a TRE-PR order that had removed social media posts questioning Dallagnol’s eligibility, ruling it violated freedom of expression, without assessing the truth of the claims.

item.title: Dino cobra informações da Câmara sobre viagem de Mario Frias ao exterior
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino has requested the Chamber of Deputies to explain the overseas trip of federal deputy Mário Frias to Bahrain, which he claims is an unauthorized international mission. Frias, who has not returned to Brazil, is under investigation for allegedly directing R$2 million in parliamentary amendments to an NGO linked to the producer of the 'Dark Horse' film about Jair Bolsonaro. The Chamber confirmed receiving the request and stated that Frias submitted two mission requests (Bahrain and Dallas), neither authorized.

item.title: Novas medidas do governo reforçam proteção das mulheres na internet
item.description: President Lula signed a decree and four laws to strengthen women's protection in digital and domestic environments, including the creation of a National Aggressors Registry, expanded immediate removal measures, harsher penalties for perpetrators who threaten after imprisonment, and reduced bureaucracy for protective orders. The announcements marked the 100-day milestone of the National Pact Against Feminicide, with Lula emphasizing education as key to changing cultural norms around gender violence.

item.title: Sem citar Flávio Bolsonaro, Zema diz a prefeitos que é preciso ter credibilidade para liderar o país
item.description: Romeu Zema, presidential pre-candidate from the Novo party, stated that governing and changing Brazil requires credibility, without directly naming Flávio Bolsonaro. His remarks came amid the crisis affecting the Bolsonarist campaign following revelations of the senator's contacts with Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master. Zema addressed mayors at an event on Wednesday.

item.title: PSDB aproveita crise com Flávio para debater eventual candidatura de Aécio à Presidência
item.description: The PSDB is considering launching Aécio Neves as a presidential pre-candidate in 2026, capitalizing on the crisis surrounding Flávio Bolsonaro, whose alleged ties to Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master have opened space in the opposition. A meeting between PSDB and Cidadania, scheduled for next Tuesday, will formally discuss the candidacy, backed by figures like Roberto Freire and Paulinho da Força. Although Ciro Gomes was mentioned as an alternative, Aécio Neves is currently the favored name of the federation for the presidential race.

item.title: A caverna de Brasília: Flávio Bolsonaro, Vorcaro e a recusa de ver a luz
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro initially denied any relationship with banker Daniel Vorcaro, who is imprisoned for involvement in Brazil's largest banking fraud, but later admitted requesting R$ 61 million to finance the film 'Dark Horse' about his father between February and May 2025. Part of the funds reportedly came from public sources, including the Rioprevidência pension fund, contradicting claims of purely private sponsorship. The Bolsonarist defense maintains it was private sponsorship for a private project, but documentary evidence and timing — while Banco Master was already under market suspicion — undermine this narrative.

item.title: Lindbergh aciona Receita, BC e Ancine para investigar “Dark Horse”
item.description: Federal Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) has urged the Federal Revenue Service, Central Bank, and Ancine to investigate the financing of the biopic 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro, following allegations of atypical R$ 61 million fund flows between Brazil and the United States. The complaint questions why a film predominantly produced in Brazil required a Brazil–U.S.–Brazil financial circuit, suggesting potential tax evasion, capital flight, or financial misconduct.

item.title: Odair Cunha toma posse como ministro do Tribunal de Contas da União
item.description: Odair Cunha was sworn in as a minister of the Federal Court of Accounts (TCU) on Wednesday (20), following a political agreement during the election of Hugo Motta as Chamber president. Nominated by the PT to fill the vacancy left by Aroldo Cedraz’s retirement, he was elected in April and had his inauguration attended by Lula, Davi Alcolumbre, and Hugo Motta. Cunha, a former federal deputy from Minas Gerais with six consecutive terms, is a lawyer specializing in Public Law and authored 18 bills that became law.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro e a sociedade com Mário Frias nas eleições de 2022
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro and Mário Frias, former federal deputies from PL-SP who were later cassated, are partners in producing the film 'Dark Horse,' which portrays the trajectory of former President Jair Bolsonaro. TSE records show that Eduardo Bolsonaro’s 2022 campaign was the second-largest financier of Mário Frias’s campaign, indicating a strong financial and political alliance between the two during that election. This relationship reflects a pattern of mutual support among Bolsonaro allies, even after the loss of their congressional seats.

item.title: Independiente Petrolero x Botafogo: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Botafogo faces Independiente Petrolero on Wednesday, May 20, at 9:00 PM Brasília time at Estadio La Huerta in Asunción, Paraguay, in Matchday 5 of Copa Sudamericana Group E. The match will be exclusively streamed on Paramount+. Botafogo has already qualified for the knockout stage and aims to win to avoid the playoff round, while Independiente Petrolero is eliminated. Alexander Barboza may be playing his last match for Botafogo before a potential transfer to Palmeiras.

item.title: Otto Lobo é aprovado para CVM em votação apressada em comissão do Senado
item.description: The Senate's Economic Affairs Committee (CAE) approved lawyer Otto Lobo for the presidency of the CVM (Securities and Exchange Commission) in a vote held on Wednesday (20), nearly five months after his nomination by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The approval took place in a process described as rushed by some senators.

item.title: O ‘erro estratégico’ da oposição que deve favorecer Lula nas próximas pesquisas
item.description: The crisis involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and audio leaks with Daniel Vorcaro exposed a strategic error by the opposition, which prematurely backed his candidacy, sidelining more moderate and competitive figures like Tarcísio de Freitas and Ratinho Júnior. Political scientist Leandro Consentino argues this weakness strengthens Lula, as the opposition fails to unite behind a single, electable candidate, while the government gains political relief from the adversary's decline.

item.title: Pacto contra o Feminicídio: Lula sanciona 4 leis e apresenta resultados de 100 dias
item.description: President Lula presented the results of the first 100 days of the National Pact Against Femicide, highlighting the reduction in the average processing time for protective measures from 16 to 3 days and the arrest of 6,328 perpetrators through Operation Safe Woman. The initiative unites the three branches of government to combat gender-based violence, with emphasis on digital tools such as the National Risk Assessment Form and the provision of special pensions for children orphaned by femicide.

item.title: Rosangela Moro aciona TSE contra Lula por suposta campanha antecipada
item.description: Federal Deputy Rosangela Moro (PL-SP) filed a representation with the TSE against President Lula, alleging premature electoral propaganda in favor of Ministers Simone Tebet and Marina Silva, identified as pre-candidates for the São Paulo Senate. The document claims Lula made explicit requests for support to both ministers, constituting premature campaigning.

item.title: Brasil e EUA iniciam negociações após visita de Lula à Casa Branca; países discutem acordos e tarifas alvo de críticas americanas
item.description: Brazil and the U.S. began trade negotiations following Lula’s visit to the White House, with a videoconference between Brazilian Minister Márcio Elias Rosa and U.S. Commerce Secretary Jamieson Greer. The meeting was described as 'excellent,' and Lula directed negotiators to seek concrete commitments from the U.S., favoring incremental agreements over a broad deal. Discussions center on U.S. concerns about Brazilian tariffs and trade barriers in steel, aluminum, and ethanol, which Washington says hinder market access for American exporters.

item.title: Por que a nova explicação de Flávio ampliou o ‘clima de velório’ entre aliados no Congresso
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro’s new explanation about his meeting with former banker Daniel Vorcaro — after Vorcaro’s release and electronic ankle monitoring — failed to reassure congressional allies and instead deepened distrust. Despite promising to disclose details about funds received for the film 'Dark Horse' within 30 days, the succession of contradictory versions eroded his political credibility, leaving even close allies unconvinced. The meeting in Brasília was described as having a 'funeral-like' atmosphere, highlighting the growing turmoil in his pre-presidential campaign.

item.title: Janaína Paschoal diz que Flávio "contaminará boas candidaturas"
item.description: City councilwoman Janaína Paschoal criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential pre-candidacy, arguing that his proximity to financier Daniel Vorcaro and the 'Dark Horse' film project already made it unviable and that he could 'contaminate' strong right-wing candidacies in the states. She urged Tarcísio de Freitas and Sergio Moro to distance themselves from Flávio to protect their electoral prospects, while stating she holds no personal grudges against the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: Ao vivo: Odair Cunha toma posse como ministro do TCU
item.description: Odair Cunha (PT-MG) is sworn in as a minister of the TCU on Wednesday, May 20, 2026, becoming the first PT-affiliated congressperson to hold a seat on the court. His appointment followed unanimous approval by the TCU plenary on his moral reputation and suitability, nomination by the Chamber of Deputies (303 votes), and Senate confirmation (50-8). President Lula attends the ceremony in Brasília.

item.title: PF apura emenda de Flávio Bolsonaro para ONG suspeita de integrar esquema de desvios comandado por irmãos Brazão
item.description: The Federal Police is investigating whether Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) directed R$199,000 in parliamentary amendments to the Instituto de Formação Profissional José Carlos Procópio (Ifop) as part of a scheme to divert public funds allegedly led by the Brazão brothers, convicted in the murder of Marielle Franco. The intermediary was Robson Calixto Fonseca (‘Peixe’), a reserve military police officer convicted of organized crime in the Marielle case, who allegedly channeled funds to NGOs linked to the brothers. Investigators are examining whether the transfer, made a month after Bolsonaro’s office was contacted by a Brazão aide at the TCE-RJ, contributed to the group’s illicit enrichment.

item.title: Renan Santos, do Missão, ironiza Flávio Bolsonaro: "Estou com dó". Veja vídeo
item.description: Renan Santos, pre-candidate for presidency from the Missão party, mocked Flávio Bolsonaro over his statements regarding Daniel Vorcaro's financing of the Jair Bolsonaro biopic, saying the senator 'embarrasses people' and that he feels 'sorry' for his situation. Santos also criticized Flávio's meeting with Vorcaro after the latter's arrest, suggesting the senator has 'serious cognitive problems' and is 'the biggest fool in the Bolsonaro family'. The AtlasIntel poll showed Lula leading, with Flávio declining and Renan Santos in third place at 6.9%, technically tied.

item.title: Salles diz que proximidade de Flávio Bolsonaro com banqueiro é imoral
item.description: Federal Deputy Ricardo Salles (Novo-SP) stated that the proximity between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and banker Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, is at least immoral, citing indications of crime and fraud at the bank prior to Vorcaro's arrest in November 2025. Despite the criticism, Salles assessed that this may not prevent a presidential candidacy by Flávio Bolsonaro in 2026, depending on the comparison with adversaries like Lula, and suggested that Michelle Bolsonaro could gain more support within the right-wing as a 'soft' figure.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro chama Alexandre de Moraes de 'irmão em Cristo'
item.description: Former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro jokingly referred to Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes as a 'brother in Christ' while commenting on a ruling that allowed jailed former president Jair Bolsonaro to remain under house arrest. The remark, made on Tuesday (19), drew attention for its informal tone toward a key judicial figure in Brazil.

item.title: Flávio despenca no Polymarket e Renan Santos fica a 10 pontos do senador
item.description: Renan Santos, pre-candidate of the Partido Missão, rose to 13% in Polymarket projections for Brazil's 2026 presidential election, while Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) fell to 23%, narrowing the gap to 10 percentage points. The shift reflects changing expectations in the international political betting market.

item.title: Vantagem nas pesquisas anima, mas governo Lula prega por ‘sandálias da humildade’
item.description: The Lula government celebrates its lead in polls following the revelation of the relationship between Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master and Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL’s pre-candidate for president. Despite the positive trend, Lula’s aides urge humility, warning against underestimating Bolsonaro’s son. The petista campaign aims to keep the scandal alive, ensuring it doesn’t ‘die on the beach’.

item.title: Ala do PL vê prestação de contas de Flávio como fator decisivo para apoiá-lo; leia bastidores
item.description: A PL faction views Flávio Bolsonaro’s promise to disclose financial accounts for the 'Dark Horse' film as decisive for supporting his presidential bid, despite criticism over his lack of transparency regarding ties to Banco Master’s owner, Daniel Vorcaro. Lawmakers argue he should have disclosed the relationship earlier to avoid suspicions of public fund misuse and money laundering, though he denies wrongdoing and claims the sponsorship logic was reasonable. His advocacy for a congressional CPI and stable polling (e.g., AtlasIntel) are seen as mitigating factors.

item.title: Lula atualiza regras, big techs deverão remover conteúdo criminoso e podem ser punidas
item.description: President Lula signed decrees updating digital platform regulations in Brazil, requiring big techs to immediately remove criminal content such as fraud, child sexual exploitation, and suicide incitement, or face penalties. Platforms must provide official channels for notifications, analyze complaints with reasoned decisions, allow user appeals, maintain transparency reports, and retain advertiser data for one year to support fraud investigations. The ANPD will oversee compliance with data protection obligations linked to the decree.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: Flávio pinóquio?
item.description: The Meio-Dia em Brasília program analyzed Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s new explanations regarding his ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master, alongside Lula’s 190-billion-real electoral package. The report also questioned the credibility of Flávio’s statements, suggesting inconsistencies in his narrative.

item.title: A estrela da publicidade que está na mira da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign is considering hiring renowned advertiser Eduardo Fischer to counter an image crisis stemming from alleged ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro. Fischer, with over three decades of experience and iconic campaigns in Brazilian advertising, is backed by the faction led by Senator Rogério Marinho, though some oppose his return due to his prolonged absence from the industry. The campaign recently brought in Marcello Lopes (Marcelão), a former police officer and owner of Cálix Propaganda, to handle communications.

item.title: Os novos decretos de Lula com regras para as big techs nas redes sociais
item.description: President Lula signed two decrees to regulate big techs on social media, including mandatory reporting channels for non-consensual nudity with removal within two hours and measures to combat digital fraud and deceptive ads. The ANPD will monitor compliance with proactive obligations to prevent the spread of criminal content.

item.title: “Não discuto resultado de urna”, diz Caiado
item.description: Former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) stated he does not dispute election results, defending respect for the electoral process and citing his experience in 10 electoral contests. He reinforced his support for municipalism, criticized centralization in Brasília, and called for a revision of the federal pact, while highlighting his security policies in Goiás and rejecting social program dependency. Caiado also criticized the federal government and Bolsonaro allies who question the electronic voting system.

item.title: Judicialização deve ser tática de campanha para Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The pre-campaigns of Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) signal that judicialization will be a central tactic in the 2026 elections, with actions already filed at the TSE to block a film about Jair Bolsonaro and suspend a sensitive poll. While the PT will repeat its 2022 strategy, now wielding state power, the opposition seeks to counter perceptions of judicial bias by relying on Bolsonaro-appointees at the TSE and plans to use the judiciary as an offensive tool, including challenging alleged abuses of public resources by the government.

item.title: O ator de ‘Dark Horse’ que segue perfis anti-Bolsonaro nas redes
item.description: Actor José Trassi, who portrays Aurélio Barba — a dramatized version of Adélio Bispo — in the film 'Dark Horse', follows anti-Bolsonaro profiles on social media, including 'DefundBolsonaro', which criticizes the ex-president's environmental policies. Trassi also follows President Lula, deputy Érika Hilton, and left-wing humor pages, and frequently speaks out on racism, indigenous rights, and land demarcation — issues often attacked by Bolsonarism.

item.title: Lula é visto como mais experiente e Flávio como mais inovador, diz Datafolha
item.description: Lula is seen as more experienced (55%) and Flávio Bolsonaro as more innovative (31%), according to a Datafolha poll from May 2026. Lula is also perceived as more corrupt (46%) than Flávio (30%) in terms of public morality. The survey was conducted before the release of an audio in which Flávio requested funds to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lula lança crédito de até R$ 30 bilhões para taxistas e motoristas de aplicativo comprarem carros novos
item.description: President Lula signed a Provisional Measure creating a credit line of up to R$ 30 billion for taxi and app-based drivers to purchase new vehicles, with special conditions and a focus on sustainable cars. The program, part of Move Brazil and operated by BNDES, requires at least 12 months of active registration and 100 rides, and will be accessible via gov.br/movebrasil starting June 19.

item.title: Ex-petista e aliada de João Campos, Marília Arraes diz não ver problema em Raquel Lyra apoiar Lula
item.description: Marília Arraes (PDT), Senate pre-candidate on João Campos' (PSB) ticket, defended Governor Raquel Lyra's (PSD) open support for Lula's re-election, criticating her 'fence-sitting' stance. She emphasized the need to unify the political field around Lula amid national polarization, while Campos seeks to nationalize his campaign as 'Lula's soldier' to push Lyra toward bolsonarism. Despite Lyra's overtures to the PT and Lula, the president has avoided taking sides, praising both as young and competent for public security.

item.title: Michelle se nega a comentar relação de Flávio Bolsonaro e Vorcaro: ‘Você devia perguntar para ele’
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro refused to comment on the relationship between her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro, stating the question should be directed to the senator. The controversy involves audio and messages where Flávio demands Vorcaro transfer 134 million reais to finance the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro's life — an amount far exceeding budgets of nationally acclaimed Brazilian films.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro chama Moraes de ‘irmão em Cristo’ e cita possível conversão do ministro do STF
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro referred to Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes as 'brother in Christ' during an event in Brasília, suggesting a possible conversion of the minister and citing the release of Jair Bolsonaro's hairstylist as a sign of divine intervention. She also posted on Instagram about forgiveness and divine justice, while declining to comment on the controversy involving her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro and his request for funds from Daniel Vorcaro for a film about the former president.

item.title: ‘Tem de perguntar a ele’, diz Michelle Bolsonaro sobre relação de Flávio com Vorcaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro declined to comment on the crisis involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, stating that Flávio should be asked directly. She said she participates in political events when possible, such as the launch of Maria Amélia’s pre-candidacy, and that her priority is caring for Jair Bolsonaro. Two opinion polls this week are testing her potential 2026 presidential run, with AtlasIntel showing 23.4% support in a first-round scenario, behind Lula’s 47%.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula é visto como o mais experiente; Flávio Bolsonaro mais moderno e inovador
item.description: Lula is seen as the most experienced candidate by 55% of voters, with a 37-point lead over Flávio Bolsonaro on this trait. Flávio Bolsonaro leads in perceptions of modernity and innovation, with 31% versus Lula’s 26%. Among unaffiliated voters, Lula maintains an experience advantage (52% vs 8%), while Flávio remains the top choice for innovation (22% vs 11%).

item.title: Congresso se prepara para derrubar veto de Lula e liberar doações durante campanha eleitoral
item.description: Congress is preparing to overturn President Lula’s veto on a provision allowing donations during the 2026 electoral campaign, effectively bypassing the 'electoral blackout' period that prohibits resource transfers and donations three months before elections. The measure, previously used under Bolsonaro in 2022, requires a counterpart from recipient municipalities and is part of a broader deal to accelerate parliamentary amendment payments, with over R$ 25.97 billion already released in 2025. Although the executive called the provision unconstitutional, it has allowed its base to overturn the veto to appease mayors gathered in Brasília for the March of Mayors.

item.title: A reação de Michelle Bolsonaro ao ser perguntada sobre ligação de Flávio e Vorcaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro declined to comment publicly on the controversy involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro, stating the matter should be addressed directly with the senator. She made the remark while leaving the event launching Maria Amélia’s pre-candidacy in Brasília on Tuesday, March 19, 2024.

item.title: “Impunidade”, diz TI Brasil sobre minirreforma eleitoral da Câmara
item.description: Transparency International – Brazil criticized the approval of the urgency of PL 4822/2025 by the Chamber of Deputados, stating that the electoral mini-reform seeks to guarantee impunity for parties that committed irregularities in past elections. The organization warns that changes to party accounting could weaken oversight and transparency in campaign financing.

item.title: Michelle evita comentar relação de Flávio com Vorcaro: 'Tem que perguntar para ele'
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro avoided commenting on Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's involvement with banker Daniel Vorcaro, stating that he should address the matter himself. Her remarks came during the launch of Maria Amélia's pre-candidacy for federal deputy in the Federal District. Flávio had previously admitted to meeting Vorcaro after his release from prison, following a leaked audio in which he demanded overdue payments for a film about Jair Bolsonaro, causing damage to his presidential pre-campaign.

item.title: Bancada do agro retoma a atitude de 'passar a boiada' e faz semana de destruição ambiental
item.description: The agribusiness bloc in Congress has resumed the practice of 'passing the cattle herd,' approving anti-environmental measures during 'Agribusiness Week,' taking advantage of public attention focused on the Banco Master scandal and Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy. Despite the sector's reliance on a balanced environment, lawmakers continue to prioritize productive interests over environmental preservation, echoing the logic promoted by Ricardo Salles during the Bolsonaro government.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio avaliam que ele precisa sair do 'inferno astral'; caso contrário, pode se tornar um candidato inviável
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) say he must escape his 'astral hell' after a tumultuous day marked by controversial visits to banker Daniel Vorcaro, under house arrest, and revelations about foreign funding for the film 'Dark Horse', which raised doubts about his electoral viability. They warn that without change, Flávio risks becoming an unviable candidate due to growing scrutiny and potential Federal Police investigations into his ties with Vorcaro.
